definitions.explanation: Performing an action with full awareness and intent, as opposed to doing it by accident or mistake.

examples.japanese: {故意|こい}に⟦やった→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I didn't do it on purpose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{故意|こい}に⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}していた→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧。

{故意|こい}に⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{科|か}せられる。
examples.english: If you deliberately violate the rules, severe penalties will be imposed.

notes:
A formal adverb used to express that an action was done on purpose. ⟦{故意|こい}→故意：16844_koi⟧ is a noun meaning "intent, deliberateness" and ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ makes it adverbial. It is particularly common in legal, news, and formal written contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {故意|こい}に⟦{壊|こわ}す→壊す：01241_kowasu⟧ — to break intentionally
- {故意|こい}に⟦{無視|むし}する→無視する：17288_mushisuru⟧ — to deliberately ignore
- {故意|こい}に⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ — to intentionally conceal
- {故意|こい}に⟦{遅|おく}らせる→遅らせる：02480_okuraseru⟧ — to delay on purpose

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦わざと→わざと：03791_wazato⟧ — on purpose, deliberately (more colloquial; used in everyday speech)
- ⟦{意図的|いとてき}→意図的：16841_itoteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — intentionally (similar formality; focuses on the planned nature)
- {意識的|いしきてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — consciously, intentionally (emphasizes awareness)

USAGE:
{故意|こい}に is more formal and written than ⟦わざと→わざと：03791_wazato⟧. In legal contexts, ⟦{故意|こい}→故意：16844_koi⟧ (as a noun) contrasts with ⟦{過失|かしつ}→過失：00194_kashitsu⟧ (negligence): {故意|こい}に⟦よる→よる：09857_yoru⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧ (intentional crime) vs. ⟦{過失|かしつ}→過失：00194_kashitsu⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧ (crime by negligence).
